Argentina Investigates Oil Projects Near Falklands; Trump Questions UK Support

Argentina has launched an investigation into oil exploration projects conducted in waters near the disputed Falkland Islands. The move follows a statement by former U.S. President Donald Trump, who expressed doubts about U.S. support for Britain in the Falklands dispute with Argentina. Trump's comments, made during a rally, suggested a potential shift in U.S. policy regarding the South Atlantic islands, which are administered by the UK but claimed by Argentina. The investigation by Argentina aims to scrutinize the environmental and legal aspects of the oil projects.
